verdict.rationale: Docs show broad API/CLI/SDK coverage mirroring UI actions—fine-tuning can be launched 'from the console, through the API/SDK, or with the CLI', dedicated endpoints can be deployed via CLI (tg beta endpoints deploy), and inference, batch, and cluster provisioning are all API-accessible—suggesting strong UI/API parity for core workflows. However, there's no explicit documentation enumerating full parity (e.g., billing, account/org management, usage dashboards) or confirming every UI-only feature has an API equivalent, and no OpenAPI spec was found (probe shows all openapi.json paths 404), making completeness hard to verify. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or API coverage for account/billing/admin functions, and a published OpenAPI spec confirming full API surface.
